scope: Repository and catalog evidence for PostgreSQL row-level security and client privileges

items.title: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY decision is incomplete
items.closureCriteria: Classify every tenant-bearing table, document owner-role traffic, apply FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY where safe, and pass owner-bypass negative tests on PostgreSQL 17.

items.title: Cross-tenant negative coverage is not complete by data class
items.closureCriteria: Add and pass PostgreSQL 17 negative suites for every reviewed tenant or owner-scoped data class, including privileged and definer-function paths.

items.title: Rule-derived table classifications require object-level review
items.closureCriteria: A named security or data owner reviews every classification exception and the checked-in register records the reviewer and review date.

items.title: Authenticated-role grant allowlist is incomplete
items.closureCriteria: Check in and test an object-level authenticated-role allowlist for SELECT and write privileges, including an explicit owner and rationale for every exception.

items.title: Supabase-managed schema privilege coverage is incomplete
items.closureCriteria: Record and independently verify the intended browser-role privileges and policy boundaries for managed storage and GraphQL objects.
